<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds two new node-exporter collector configurations: `softirqs` and `interrupts`. New exported Go types `NodeExporterCollectorSoftirqsConfig` and `NodeExporterCollectorInterruptsConfig` and corresponding fields on `NodeExporterCollectorConfig` were added. Manifest generation sets `--collector.<name>` or `--no-collector.<name>` based on these configs. Unit and e2e tests were extended to cover both collectors. Documentation, telemetry manifests, and sample queries were updated to include `softirqs` and `interrupts`. Both collectors are documented and implemented as disabled by default.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes
